title: Divisors and the divisor class group: existing in file 06
text:
For a curve $C$ over a field, the *divisors* ($D=\sum_Pn_P[P]$,
$\operatorname{Div}(C)$, principal divisors, the divisor class group
$\operatorname{Cl}(C)$ and the associated module $\mathcal{O}_C(D)$ of a
divisor, defined via $k(C)$) are those of file 06: [def-sc-divisor].
In this blueprint they are used for the curve $X$ and its base changes
$X_K$; the corresponding invertible module of an effective Cartier
divisor is the one of [def-pc-divisor-line-bundle]
([lem-pc-divisor-line-bundle-agrees-sc]).
